name: Phase-Aware Gradient Descent (PAGD)
definition: A phase-aware optimizer used to encode wave fields into phase-only holograms for 3D holographic displays, mitigating ringing artifacts and unnatural blur spreading found in amplitude-only or RGB-D methods.
summary: Phase-Aware Gradient Descent is an optimization method that encodes complex wave fields into phase-only holograms by supervising phase rather than amplitude, distinguishing itself from iterative algorithms through gradient-based loss minimization with a learned forward model.
